snippet.title: U.R.B.A.N - The Cyborg Project Longplay (DOS, 1999)
snippet.description:
A Longplay of U.R.B.A.N - The Cyborg Project. 

A freeware game for DOS / Win 9x systems where the objective is to violently murder everybody to heavy metal music MOD music.

10/10 game, especially for a freeware 90's game.
